text: The first time you open the ByggExp app, the home screen shows four steps to get started. Let's go through them together.
First, choose the project you'll be working on. The first step is done.
Next, report your time. You choose how: automatically with GPS on site, enter hours directly, or in Arbetspass.
We choose Arbetspass. The app briefly shows how it works.
Under the Manuell tab, tap the day in the calendar and enter your hours – eight hours, Monday to Friday.
Save – and the month shows forty hours.
The next step is your profile – your name and email are already there.
Fill in your trade, for example concrete worker. You can also add a phone number and documents, such as certificates.
Tap the check mark to save – your profile is updated.
Last step: customise the home screen.
First, pick the theme you like.
Under Runda knappar, choose what the second big button does: camera, hours or play.
Under Knappar, turn on what you use every day, for example chats and Arbetspass, and turn off what you don't need.
Now the home screen has a camera button – perfect for taking photos on site.
Done – the home screen shows only what you need. The app is ready for work.
